classification.difficultyReason: Construct a table at 15-degree intervals and use it to sketch a sine function with two cycles and amplitude 3.

content.prompt: Draw up a table of values of $y=3\sin 2\theta$ for $0^\circ\leq\theta\leq360^\circ$. Use increments of $15^\circ$ and work to one decimal place. Sketch the graph of $y=3\sin 2\theta$ for $0^\circ\leq\theta\leq360^\circ$.

answer.short: The graph has amplitude $3$ and period $180^\circ$. Zeros occur at $0^\circ,90^\circ,180^\circ,270^\circ,360^\circ$; maxima at $(45^\circ,3)$ and $(225^\circ,3)$; minima at $(135^\circ,-3)$ and $(315^\circ,-3)$.

inlines.text: Evaluate in degree mode, keeping unrounded values until the final table entries. For example,
Plot the table points and join them with a smooth sine curve. Multiplying the sine values by 3 gives amplitude 3; doubling the angle gives period

spec.mathematics: y=3 sin(2 theta), with theta in degrees, on the closed interval 0 to 360. Zeros at 0,90,180,270,360; maxima at 45,225; minima at 135,315.
